valueType.name: EgressPolicyRule
valueType.doc: A single egress policy rule. Rules are evaluated in order; first match wins. A rule has either a static EgressPolicyRuleAction? EgressPolicyRule.Action or a dynamic EgressPolicyHookRef? EgressPolicyRule.HookRef, never both. When EgressPolicyHookRef? EgressPolicyRule.HookRef is set, the proxy calls the configured webhook at request time and applies the returned decision in place of EgressPolicyRuleAction? EgressPolicyRule.Action.

type.name: EgressPolicyRuleMatch
type.doc: Request matching criteria for an egress policy rule. All specified conditions must match (AND logic). EgressPolicyMatchScheme? EgressPolicyRuleMatch.Scheme is nullable; null means the author did not specify a scheme and the effective default is resolved per rule polarity at evaluation time. A static Deny defaults to EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Any so a block is not silently scoped to HTTPS and bypassed over HTTP. Every other rule — including positive rules (Allow / Transform / Rewrite) and dynamic EgressPolicyHookRef? EgressPolicyRule.HookRef rules (whose outcome can be Allow/Transform/Rewrite or fail open) — defaults to EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Https: on plaintext HTTP there is no SNI, so matching uses the sandbox-controlled Host header with no certificate validation, and a positive or hook match there would let a sandbox reach a non-allowlisted IP while spoofing an allowlisted Host. Set EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Any explicitly to match both schemes, or EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Http / EgressPolicyMatchScheme.Https to pin a single scheme. For IP-based match hosts, scheme matching is ignored (no TLS certificate validation applies to IPs anyway).bool? EgressPolicyRuleMatch.NormalizePath controls whether the request path is decoded and normalized (encoded-slash decode, slash merging, and ./.. dot-segment removal) before it is matched against string? EgressPolicyRuleMatch.Path. It defaults to enabled (null is treated as true) to prevent path-confusion bypasses where an encoded path such as /allowed%2F.. matches an allow rule but the upstream server resolves it to a different path. Set to false only for upstreams that require the raw, un-normalized path.

type.name: EgressPolicyRuleAction
type.doc: The action to take when a rule matches. For Rewrite actions, Scheme/Host/Path specify the destination to rewrite the request to, and EgressRuleRoutingMode EgressPolicyRuleAction.RoutingMode optionally overrides the sandbox-level egress routing for this rule.

type.name: EgressPolicyHookRef
type.doc: Configures a webhook called at request time for rules whose static decision cannot be expressed declaratively. When a rule's EgressPolicyHookRef? EgressPolicyRule.HookRef is set, the egress proxy POSTs a request-context payload to string EgressPolicyHookRef.Endpoint and applies the returned decision (Allow / Deny / Transform / Rewrite) in place of the rule's static Action.  EgressRuleRoutingMode EgressPolicyHookRef.RoutingMode controls how the egress proxy reaches the webhook endpoint itself: EgressRuleRoutingMode.Vnet binds the outbound socket to the sandbox's customer VNET IP (so the hook host can be a private service reachable only from inside the VNET), EgressRuleRoutingMode.Platform forces the node's platform egress, and EgressRuleRoutingMode.Default uses the sandbox-level routing. The webhook response itself can also carry a `routingMode` field that overrides routing for the downstream upstream call when the decision is Rewrite.

type.name: TdsEgressSection

IReadOnlyList<TdsCredential> TdsEgressSection.Credentials is a list of named credentials (each string TdsCredential.Name unique within the section), declared once and referenced by name from static rules and webhook responses. The array-of-named-objects shape matches the rest of the Azure Container Apps Sandbox API (for example Connections); the runtime resolves it into a by-name map. On the runtime path each credential's string? TdsCredential.Secret is resolved.

valueType.name: TdsCredential
valueType.doc: A declared TDS credential. string TdsCredential.Name uniquely identifies the credential within its TdsEgressSection and is what rules (string? TdsEgressAction.Credential) and webhook responses reference. On the API/contract path EgressPolicySecretRef? TdsCredential.SecretRef is set and string? TdsCredential.Secret is null. On the runtime path (after Global API resolution) string? TdsCredential.Secret holds the resolved material and flows (encrypted) to NodeAgent.

valueType.name: TdsEgressRule
valueType.doc: A single TDS egress rule. Rules are evaluated in order; first match wins. A rule has exactly one of TdsEgressAction? TdsEgressRule.Action (static) or EgressPolicyHookRef? TdsEgressRule.HookRef (dynamic webhook), never both — same XOR as HTTP.

type.name: TransportEgressSection
type.doc: The transport (L3/L4 TCP/UDP) section of an egress policy. Distinct from HTTP and TDS policy and enforced by NodeAgent at the network layer (`iptables`). EgressPolicyActionType TransportEgressSection.DefaultAction is the terminal action applied to raw TCP/UDP flows that match no rule; IReadOnlyList<TransportEgressRule> TransportEgressSection.Rules is capped at 10 entries. DNS (port 53) is always carved out and never constrained by these rules in v1.

valueType.name: TransportEgressRule
valueType.doc: A single L3/L4 transport egress rule. Rules are evaluated in declared order; first match wins. EgressPolicyActionType TransportEgressRule.Action must be Allow or Deny (Transform/Rewrite are HTTP-only and rejected by validation). string TransportEgressRule.Destination is an IPv4 CIDR (v1). int? TransportEgressRule.Port is a single destination port (`1..65535`) or `null` to match every port on the destination (any-port wildcard).
